passages.title: A Short History of the Bicycle

sentences.text: The first machine that can be called a bicycle appeared in Germany in 1817 and was made almost entirely of wood.
It had two wheels of the same size but no pedals, so the rider pushed it along with their feet.
Pedals were added in the 1860s, attached directly to the front wheel, which grew larger and larger over the following years.
The famous penny-farthing, with its huge front wheel, could travel fast but was difficult to mount and dangerous to fall from.
The modern design arrived in 1885, with a chain driving the back wheel and two wheels of equal size.
Within a few years, the new bicycle had become cheap enough for ordinary workers, and by the 1890s cycling was one of the most popular pastimes in Britain and America.
Historians note that the bicycle also changed what women wore, because long skirts were impractical on the new machines.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Good afternoon, City Museum. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I would like to book tickets for the special exhibition on Saturday, please.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Certainly. Adult tickets are fifteen pounds each. How many would you like?

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Two adults and one child, please.

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Children under sixteen pay half price, so the child ticket is seven pounds fifty.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: I am a member of the museum. Is there a discount for members?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: Yes, members get twenty per cent off the total. Your total before the discount is thirty-seven pounds fifty.

lines.speaker: Woman
lines.text: Thank you. What time does the exhibition open on Saturday?

lines.speaker: Clerk
lines.text: It opens at nine thirty, and the last entry is at four thirty.

items.stem: The earliest bicycle was made mostly of wood.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài nói chiếc xe đầu tiên xuất hiện ở Đức năm 1817, làm gần như hoàn toàn bằng gỗ.
explanation.whyWrong: Không phải NOT GIVEN vì chất liệu của xe được nói rõ ở câu đầu.
explanation.trap: Cụm 'almost entirely' tương đương 'mostly' trong câu hỏi.

evidence.quote: The first machine that can be called a bicycle appeared in Germany in 1817 and was made almost entirely of wood.

items.stem: Riders of the first bicycle used pedals to move it forward.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài nói xe đầu tiên không có bàn đạp; người lái dùng chân đẩy xe đi.
explanation.whyWrong: Bàn đạp chỉ xuất hiện vào thập niên 1860, không thuộc chiếc xe đầu tiên.
explanation.trap: Chi tiết bàn đạp ở câu sau dễ bị gán nhầm cho chiếc xe đầu tiên.

evidence.quote: It had two wheels of the same size but no pedals, so the rider pushed it along with their feet.

items.stem: The penny-farthing was more popular in Britain than in America.

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài không so sánh độ phổ biến của penny-farthing giữa Anh và Mỹ.
explanation.trap: Câu 6 nói về đạp xe nói chung, không riêng loại xe bánh lớn này.

nearMiss.quote: Within a few years, the new bicycle had become cheap enough for ordinary workers, and by the 1890s cycling was one of the most popular pastimes in Britain and America.
nearMiss.whyNotEnough: Bài nói đạp xe nói chung rất phổ biến ở Anh và Mỹ, không so sánh riêng penny-farthing giữa hai nước.

notGivenProof.result: Không câu nào so sánh độ phổ biến của penny-farthing giữa Anh và Mỹ.

items.stem: What problem did the penny-farthing have?

explanation.whyCorrect: Bài nói xe bánh lớn chạy nhanh nhưng khó leo lên và nguy hiểm khi ngã.
explanation.whyWrong: Lựa chọn a ngược bài vì xe chạy nhanh. Lựa chọn d nói về mẫu xe đời sau, rẻ cho công nhân.
explanation.trap: Mỗi lựa chọn sai mượn chi tiết của một mẫu xe khác trong bài.

items.stem: How much will the woman pay in total as a member?

explanation.whyCorrect: Tổng trước giảm là 37,50 bảng; hội viên giảm 20 phần trăm nên cô trả 30 bảng.

explanation.trap: Câu này cần tính một bước từ tổng tiền và tỉ lệ giảm giá.
